section_sequence.what_it_does: Left-aligned two-line headline, grey subline, 'New Loops ->' link at right, then a full-width dark app-UI mock (issue view + agent chat panel) with a soft glow beneath.
One row of customer wordmarks with a small mono caption.
Large two-tone paragraph (white lead sentence, grey continuation) over three wireframe-isometric illustration cards (Purpose-built, Powered by agents, Designed for speed).
Two-column intro (heading left, text + Learn more right), wide UI mock (Slack thread + kanban), then a 3-col feature link list.
Same template; timeline and 'Cycle time by agent' scatter chart mock.
Same template; row of agent chat windows (Cursor, Linear, ChatPRD).
Same template; review list + code diff mock.
Heading and four dated entries on a dotted timeline, View all link.
Two cards: large lavender-gradient quote card and a narrow neon-yellow card; line about 40,000 teams.
Centred 'Built for the future. Available today.' with two pill buttons.
Logo plus five link columns, legal row.

motion.observed: t=0: subline dim and the UI mock an empty dark frame; 0.7s: mock fading in at low opacity; 1.8s: mock fully in and the 'New Loops ->' link appears.
At 3.5s the agent chat panel shows 'Thinking...'; at 8s it reads 'Worked for 10 sec' - a scripted, timed demo.
UI mocks and feature lists appear dim/low-opacity in several scroll frames and in the full page, then brighter when centred: in-view reveals (inferred).
Cyan dot clusters in the cycle-time chart differ between frames.

reduced_motion: Reduced-motion hero renders the settled state immediately (full mock, agent panel visible); running_animations 82 normal vs 76 reduced.
mobile: At 393px a sticky header keeps Log in / Sign up + hamburger. The headline wraps to 4 lines, and the hero mock bleeds off the right edge. Logos, the three illustration cards and the two quote cards become horizontally overflowing rows. Each feature section puts its heading + copy + Learn more above a cropped mock and drops the 3-col link lists. The footer goes 2-column (Product/Features, Company/Resources, Connect/Legal).
adaptable_ideas: One repeatable section template (heading left / copy + link right / wide product mock / 3-col link list) keeps a long page coherent.
Two-tone paragraph headings: bright lead sentence, dimmed continuation, as a hierarchy tool without size change.
Stage the hero reveal: text de-blurs first, product mock fades in second, a live-looking demo detail last.
Keep the page near-monochrome and spend colour on one late section (quote cards) so it lands.
